body: The JuliaHub version badge (`juliahub.com/docs/General/CloudMicrophysics/stable/version.svg`) returns a 502, so the Version row of the README badge table renders as a broken image. This switches it to the shields.io GitHub release badge, which resolves and shows the latest tag (currently v0.45.0), and links the badge to the releases page.
title: Point the README version badge at GitHub releases

body:
Release PR for 0.46.0. Since 0.45.0:

- Khairoutdinov and Kogan (2000) autoconversion and accretion as 1-moment options, with a prescribed droplet number (#814, Anna Jaruga).
- The KK2000 kernels are shared between the 1-moment and 2-moment schemes (`Common.KK2000_autoconversion`, `Common.KK2000_accretion`) and normalize their dimensional inputs by reference values; this requires ClimaParams 1.3.3, where `KK2000_autoconversion_coeff_A` is the published 1350 (compat raised to `ClimaParams = "1.3.3"`).
- README version badge points at GitHub releases (#819).

A registry PR capping ClimaParams at 1.3.2 for CloudMicrophysics 0.42 - 0.45 is open at JuliaRegistries/General#172413, since those versions compute wrong KK2000 rates with ClimaParams 1.3.3.
title: Bump version to 0.46.0
